name: Dictator
description: Offline voice dictation. Press Ctrl+Alt+Space, speak, press Enter: the text is typed where your cursor was. Speech recognition runs on your computer with a sandboxed, network-less model (NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3, CC BY 4.0); audio never leaves the machine and the clipboard is not used. 25 European languages (turn on the ones you speak; mixing them works). Needs the Dictator helper and model, installed separately (see the project page). Not affiliated with NVIDIA.
